modules.scope: HTML5 media subset: <video src>, <audio src>, nested <source src>, plus T-137 `<embed src>` and `<iframe src>` when the target is a direct media file, JSON-LD `contentUrl`/`embedUrl`/`url` through the T-136 helpers, and one bounded meta-refresh hop through UrlPolicy in `GenericIE`; T-138 adds `.m3u8`/`.mpd` discovery in `src`/`data-*` attributes and raw page text, feeding the existing `M3u8`/`Mpd` parsers. Relative URL resolution; UrlPolicy on every candidate; reached through the `GenericIE` base and the registry. A non-media iframe is never crawled, the `Refresh` response header is not read, and there is still no playlist expansion, live/DRM handling beyond the typed parser failures, or JSON-LD metadata mapping.

Single video via the JS-less visionos client and, with the runtime, the web client: watch?v=, youtu.be/, /shorts/, /embed/, /live/, youtube-nocookie.com/embed/, music.youtube.com/watch?v=; metadata and streamingData formats; signatureCipher and n resolved through the bundled solver and merged visionos-first. T-124 adds the E-13 PO-token provider hook (`serviceIntegrityDimensions`), drops web-client formats until a GVS token is configured, and fills subtitle tracks and chapter markers on the info dict. Live streams, playlists, channels, comments, and the remaining innertube clients stay partial.

Innertube search subset for the D6 matcher: WEB_REMIX songs/videos and WEB video results parsed to video id, title, channel/artists, album, duration, views, and the verified song flag, with the request context/headers from `_tab.py`'s `_search_results`. T-124 accounts for `YoutubeSearchURLIE`/`YoutubeMusicSearchURLIE`: the search-URL extractors and continuations are not registered; only the matcher call exists.

Tab URL subset: /playlist?list=, /watch?...&list= (including RD... mixes), /channel/<UC id>, and /@handle (with an optional tab). One innertube `browse` request with the web client context; flat playlistVideoRenderer/playlistPanelVideoRenderer/videoRenderer/gridVideoRenderer/reelItemRenderer video id and title pairs in document order; T-124 follows continuation pages in order (bounded at 10) up to the hard cap of 50 and applies the T-124 `--playlist-items` selection (1-based ranges, negatives, steps) before the cap. `/c/` and `/user/` match the URL but fail typed because `navigation/resolve_url` is not translated; feeds and cookies stay partial.

Single public status through the public syndication guest lookup: x.com, twitter.com, mobile.x.com, mobile.twitter.com /user/status/<id> (plus www/m and i/web forms); tweet metadata; media grouped by stable media id; MP4 and HLS variants; photo-only, protected, and deleted fail typed. No GraphQL or legacy API, no cookies, no stored guest token, no photos, quoted tweets, or download; T-125 puts cards, Amplify, broadcasts, Spaces, and the shortener in the sibling `TwitterRemainder.kt` modules.

`/i/cards/tfw/v1/<id>` and `/i/videos/tweet/<id>` match and delegate to the status extractor through the registry `redirectUrl` seam, mirroring upstream `url_result(TwitterIE)`. The card page itself is not scraped.

`amp.twimg.com/v/<uuid>`: the `twitter:amplify:vmap` meta is read and the VMAP `videoVariant`/`MediaFile` subset is parsed into formats (URL-decoded variant URLs, bitrate, URL dimensions, player-meta dimensions on the first format) plus the `twitter:image:src` thumbnail. The m3u8 manifest is not expanded at extraction time; subtitles from the VMAP are not mapped.

`/i/broadcasts/<id>` and `/i/events/<id>` match and fail typed: extraction needs `broadcasts/show.json` and `live_video_stream/status/<media_key>` with the Twitter API bearer and guest tokens, which are not committed.

`/i/spaces/<13-char id>` matches and fails typed: extraction needs the `AudioSpaceById` GraphQL query and `live_video_stream/status/<media_key>` with the Twitter API bearer token, which is not committed.

InfoExtractor base (`_VALID_URL`, `suitable`, `_match_id`, `_real_extract`), info dict and format model, typed errors, HTTP helper (`_download_webpage`, `_download_json`), and the helper subset D4's extractors call. `build_format_selector` grammar (SINGLE, GROUP, PICKFIRST, MERGE) and `_build_format_filter`; best/worst/type/`*`/`.N` selection, filters, `/` fallback, `,` lists that keep every child selection, `all` (every format, best first), `mergeall` (one merged selection over every usable stream), `+` merge products, and the incomplete-format fallback. No extractor sort fields and no option surface.

searchRegex (`_search_regex`), htmlSearchMeta (`_html_search_meta`), parseJson (`_parse_json`), jsToJson (`js_to_json` subset: comments, single/backtick quotes, unquoted keys, trailing commas, undefined/void 0, hex/octal, new Date/new X, parseInt; no vars, templates, or new Map), traverse (`traverse_obj` subset), urlOrNone, intOrNone, floatOrNone, strOrNone, unescapeHtml, parseAgeLimit (`parse_age_limit`), parseCodecs, mimetype2ext, determineExt (`determine_ext` with the `KNOWN_EXTENSIONS` subset the HLS/DASH slice needs), parseIso8601, unifiedStrdate, parseFilesize, the RFC 1321 `md5Hex` the Bilibili WBI signature needs, and the `FormatSorter` field tables and preference tuple logic. The visionos INNERTUBE_CLIENTS entry, `_extract_context` language/UTC handling, `generate_api_headers` (client name/version, origin, visitor id, user agent), the `youtubei/v1/player` call shape, and T-124's optional player PO-token field. The remaining pin clients the authed path uses (web_embedded, tv_downgraded) and the android/ios/mweb/tv/web_music/web_creator tables are not translated; cookies ride the shared T-018 jar instead.

Single-video URL subset, visionos player request, `_get_checkok_params`, playbackContext, playability-status error mapping, streamingData to format fields, http_chunk_size, single-video metadata, subtitle tracks, chapter markers, and GVS/player PO-token gating. The public challenge request/response model (`JsChallengeType.N`/`SIG`, N/Sig challenge inputs and outputs) and the batch solve contract. The provider plugin registry, preferences, and the other provider kinds are not translated.

The stdin/stdout solver protocol: player/preprocessed input, batched n/sig requests, responses, `preprocessed_player` reuse, and typed errors. The bundled yt-dlp-ejs 0.8.0 scripts, their Unlicense, and the upstream SHA3-512 hashes are in `third_party/yt-dlp-ejs/0.8.0/`; the NPM/Deno/Bun script sources, cache files, and runtime updates are not translated.

expect_info_dict/expect_value matcher semantics from test/test_download.py and test/helpers.py: exact values, md5:, int/str/float, re:, count:, startswith:, mincount:, maxcount:, nested dicts; the fixture-store transfer and the redactor. The Python test runner is not translated.

Non-live media and master playlists: variants, byte ranges, EXT-X-MAP, EXT-X-KEY AES-128 (explicit IV or media sequence), EXT-X-DISCONTINUITY concatenation, sequential fragment fetch with bounded retries, and AES-128-CBC decryption in Kotlin. Live playlists, SAMPLE-AES, other key methods, and FFmpeg remuxing fail typed.

Static MPD subset: Period/AdaptationSet/Representation to formats, SegmentTemplate with $Number$/$Time$ and timelines, SegmentList with media ranges, and SegmentBase initialization ranges; fragments concatenate through the same downloader. DRM (ContentProtection) and live (dynamic) manifests fail typed; no FFmpeg.

Sequential fragment fetch through the request port into one temp file: init segment first, per-fragment ranges, AES-128-CBC decryption, bounded retries, fragment-ratio progress marked as an estimate, and cancellation between fragments that discards the file. No concurrent fragment downloads, no merge/mux, no FFmpeg.

The metadata and SMIL subset of the ThePlatform base: `_download_theplatform_metadata`, `_parse_theplatform_metadata` (title, description, thumbnail, duration, pubDate, billing code, rating, chapters, captions), and a small SMIL reader for the generated `link.theplatform.com` documents. The `ThePlatformIE` URL extractor, F4M handling, hdnea-cookie query rewrite, geo-verification headers, and hmac-signed feed URLs land with the D18 `theplatform.py` file.

The shared NBCU page walk (`_extract_nbcu_video`), the two-step SMIL-to-m3u8 selection (`_download_nbcu_smil_and_extract_m3u8_url`), the `{folders}` template fill, and the DRM check. Adobe Pass paths stop at the typed login wall; the port's InfoDict does not model `media_type`, `categories`, `episode`, season/episode numbers, `series`, `creators`, `tags`, `location`, or `_old_archive_ids`.

`nbc.com[/classic-tv]/<show>/video/<slug>/<id>`: the friendship.nbc.co `bonanzaPage` GraphQL metadata and the PRELOAD fallback; TP metadata supplies title/description/duration/date/uploader/chapters/captions, and the SMIL manifest supplies the HLS URL. A `locked` video fails typed as a TV-provider login wall.

The local-station pages (`nbcbayarea` and siblings): `data-videos`/`data-meta` plus the `nbc` script JSON map title, summary, timestamp, direct mp4, and the SMIL video list; the live HEAD check is not performed and the `dataLayer` fallbacks are best-effort.
`bravotv.com` and `oxygen.com` episode/video pages walk the TVE deck or LS playlist and share the NBCU SMIL path; an `auth` entitlement fails typed as a TV-provider login wall.
`syfy.com/<show>/season-N/episode-N[/videos]/<slug>` walks the TVE deck or LS playlist and shares the NBCU SMIL path; an `auth` entitlement fails typed as a TV-provider login wall.

`cbc.ca/<section>/<...>/<slug>` article pages: the `window.__INITIAL_STATE__` media ids, the `CBC.APP.Caffeine.initInstance` entries with the tpfeed/ThePlatform clip lookups, and the iframe/player/guid regexes become `https://www.cbc.ca/player/play/<id>` child-job entries. The `polopoly_media` and `app.contentId` paths are translated; title/description come from the OG meta.

`cbc.ca/player/play[/video]/<id>`, `i/caffeine/syndicate/?mediaId=`, and `cbcplayer:<id>`: the currentClip state maps title/description/thumbnail/date/duration, text tracks, chapters, and the `medianet` asset JSON to a `m3u8_native` HLS record or a direct asset URL. The direct https-mp4 HEAD probe is not performed (no HEAD in the extractor seam) and a media-id-only clip fails typed because its deprecated ThePlatform path needs the D18 `theplatform.py` player.
`cbc.ca/player/<category>` listings: the `clipsByCategory` state maps each item to a `/player/play/<id>` child-job entry.

The CBC Gem show and media-validation APIs (`_call_show_api`, `_call_media_api`, `_extract_item_info`) with the typed error mapping (geo, password login, unavailable); the OAuth login/refresh and claims-token flow is not translated, so a video whose validation requires an account fails typed instead of signing in.

`gem.cbc.ca[/media]/<show>/s<NN>e<NN>`: the show API item and the `gem` validation response map title (with the numeric-episode title split), description, thumbnail, duration, availability date, and age rating; the HLS manifest is recorded `m3u8_native` with `manifestType=`. Per-variant descriptive-audio preference is not available because the master is parsed at download time.
`gem.cbc.ca[/media]/<show>/s<NN>`: the season lineup becomes child-job entries at `gem.cbc.ca/media/<item>` with the item title.
`gem.cbc.ca/<slug>` landing pages: Next.js data routes a Standalone item to its media URL (the Olympics form) or to `<slug>/s01e01`, and a Season/Parts item to its playlist URLs.

`gem.cbc.ca/<slug>-<digits>/s01e<digits>`: the `formattedIdMedia` item maps the title, description, thumbnail, replay duration, and release date; the `medianetlive` validation supplies the HLS URL. An upcoming live event fails typed with `NotYetAvailable`.

`gem.cbc.ca/live/<id>` and `live-event/<id>`: the Next.js root, `event`, or `freeTv.streams` item maps title/description/thumbnail/date; the `medianetlive` validation supplies the HLS URL, and the live/replay flag comes from `isVodEnabled`.

`cbc.ca/listen/(cbc-podcasts|live-radio)/<...>/<...>/<id>`: the clips API maps the direct media URL, title, description, duration, and airdate; when the API fails, the `__PRELOADED_STATE__` episodes are searched as a fallback.

The shared Niconico constants and client headers. The port always uses the guest API: `is_logged_in` and the whole `_perform_login` flow (session cookies, MFA) are not translated, so an account-only video fails typed through the API payment flags or the refusal response.

`nicovideo.jp/(watch|shorts|embed|sp)/<id>`: the guest watch API maps title, description, duration, date, counts, channel/owner, thumbnails with parsed resolution, and `availability`; the access-rights HLS call returns a `m3u8_native` master. The 400/404 API error body (`errorCode`/`reasonCode`) is not readable through the typed HTTP seam, so scheduled, geo, PPV, premium, and member-only refusals fail typed as unavailable instead of a named reason. Per-variant quality fields and danmaku comment subtitles are not modeled.
The paged `items[].video` listing helper with the page-size termination used by the mylist and series APIs.
`nicovideo.jp[/user/<id>]/(my/)mylist/<id>` and `nico.ms/mylist/<id>`: the `v2/mylists` API maps the list name/description and its items to `/watch/<id>` child entries.
`nicovideo.jp[/user/<id>]/series/<id>` and `nico.ms/series/<id>`: the `v2/series` API maps the detail title/description and its items to child entries.
`/my/history[/like]` needs the `v1/users/me` APIs, which require login cookies; the account listing is a login wall and is not translated.
The `data-video-id` page scan with the empty-page termination shared by the search URL and tag URL extractors.
The `nicosearch:` keyword pseudo-URL is not an HTTP URL the UI accepts; the search page URL form is handled by NicovideoSearchURLIE.
`nicovideo.jp/search/<query>`: page-by-page `data-video-id` scanning until an empty page, emitted as `/watch/<id>` child entries.
The `nicosearchdateall:` keyword pseudo-URL with the date partitioning is not an HTTP URL the UI accepts; not translated.
`nicovideo.jp/tag/<tag>`: the same `data-video-id` page scan as the search URL form.
`nicovideo.jp/user/<id>[/video]`: the `v2/users/<id>/videos` API pages by `totalCount` and emits the `essential.id` values as `/watch/<id>` child entries.
Live pages and age-restricted lives need the WebSocket `startWatching` handshake (and the age-auth cookie path); the port has no WebSocket seam, so the live URL form is not translated.
